description: Generate a CLIENT-READY design audit report for an agency to send to its client: a Standout Score, what's holding the page back, what to fix and why it matters, a client-safe summary, and the page screenshots — all in plain language with NO internal jargon. Pass url for the current page; optionally pass after_url (or after_source) for a rebuilt version to get a true before/after with both screenshots and the score improvement. Pass agency_name to WHITE-LABEL it: the report text and the shareable public report page both read 'Prepared by {agency}', ready to send to the client as your own.

after_source.description: Raw HTML/CSS of the rebuilt page, for a before/after comparison

after_url.description: The rebuilt (after) page URL, for a before/after comparison

agency_name.description: White-label: your agency/studio name, shown as 'Prepared by X' in the report and on the shareable report page

business.description: Business name/description for the report header and classification

source.description: Raw HTML/CSS of the current page, if not published

url.description: The current (before) page URL to audit

name: client_report
